messages.content: Before you reserve the Hampton, put both hotels on the same basis. I need two nights with taxes and every mandatory fee, plus the airport transportation we would actually use.

The Hampton is $418.00 for two nights plus $79.62 in tax, totaling $497.62. It has no mandatory property fee. Using the Blue Line and a short car Tuesday night, then a rideshare to O'Hare Thursday, transportation is estimated at $77.00. With the $336.00 flights, the trip total is $910.62. The convening hotel is $410.00 for two nights, $77.46 in tax, and a mandatory $36.00 destination fee, totaling $523.46. Its slightly simpler airport transfers are estimated at $67.00. That complete trip would be $926.46, or $15.84 more than the Hampton plan.
Does that destination-fee total already cover both nights? I do not want another charge appearing at checkout.

Yes. The quoted $36.00 is the full mandatory destination fee for the two-night stay, and the $523.46 hotel total includes it and all listed taxes. Optional purchases and incidental holds are the only items outside that figure.
Now verify the cancellation cutoff and Thursday luggage storage for each one.

The Hampton can be canceled without penalty until 6:00 p.m. Chicago time on the Monday before arrival; after that, the penalty is one night's room and tax. The convening hotel requires cancellation by 4:00 p.m. Sunday and also charges one night's room and tax afterward. Both front desks confirmed complimentary luggage storage after Thursday checkout, with pickup later that afternoon.

My approved amount is $925 before meals and Dallas transportation, so the convening hotel misses it even though only slightly. Reserve the Hampton at $497.62, keep the airport plan at $77, and leave the flights unticketed.

The Hampton is reserved for Tuesday and Wednesday nights at an all-in total of $497.62 under confirmation CHI-HAM-62418. Payment is due at checkout, and free cancellation ends at 6:00 p.m. Chicago time on the Monday before arrival. Complimentary Thursday luggage storage is noted. The airport plan remains Blue Line plus a short car Tuesday night and a rideshare to ORD around 3:45 p.m. Thursday, estimated at $77.00. With the selected $336.00 flights, the working total is $910.62, which is $14.38 under the approved amount. The flights remain unticketed.
